newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares end off highs on profit taking.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares end off highs on profit taking.

text.p: Portuguese shares ended off highs on profit taking, affected by exchange rate instability among "Club Med" countries and a weaker dollar, dealers said. They said further exchange rate instability could hurt share prices tomorrow. Among the most active stocks were ship repairer Lisnave which hit a high for the year of 746 escudos, Portugal Telecom and Banco Comercial Portugues.
